title: Load a design image
responsibility: Reads a design image for the shown project and commit and provides a temporary browser URL that the caller can release.

inputs.name: imageUrl.workspace
inputs.description: The Workspace whose bridge, snapshot revision commit, and context are read to build the image request. A read is attempted only when the request, bridge, and commit are truthy; otherwise the callback only receives its initial empty values.

inputs.name: imageUrl.request
inputs.description: A nullable object with entityId, version, and sha256 string fields that is spread into the bridge image request when the workspace has a bridge and commit. The helper does not validate these strings, and null skips the read.

inputs.name: imageUrl.apply
inputs.description: The callback immediately receives empty URL and error strings, then receives a completion only when a bridge image read starts and settles before cleanup. Success supplies a temporary object URL for bytes wrapped as image/png and an empty error; a caught failure supplies an empty URL and String(cause).

outputs.name: imageUrl
outputs.description: The returned disposer marks pending work as disposed and suppresses its later callback. If a URL has been created, it schedules revocation after Svelte tick; it does not cancel the bridge image request.
